coordinate_order: preserved from ETOPO; inspect coordinates, do not assume south-up

methods.slope: central differences on native grid with latitude-dependent horizontal spacing; first-order outer boundaries
methods.land_fraction: fraction of samples at or above EGM2008 zero; modern relief descriptor only

limitations: Geographic summaries, not the final equal-area simulation mesh
Zero elevation is not an ancient shoreline classification
Mean slope does not resolve pass connectivity; retain native relief
No population movement law inferred from slope
